title: Rotational Inertia
text: Ideal mechanical rotational inertia, 4 inputs, 3 outputs; {Port Configuration} sets the configuration, {Output Info bus} sets the selection, {External inertia input} sets the input rotational inertia, {Rotational inertia, J} sets the inertia .01, {Torsional damping, b} sets the damping .001 and {Initial velocity, omega_o} sets the angular. Values come from the instance.
